verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents itself as a drop-in replacement for Terraform that preserves existing workflows and configurations, and it commits to backwards compatibility. Independent community reports describe migration as essentially s/terraform/opentofu/g, and a consultancy reports moving several clients over. Missing for 10: a first-party migration guide covering state-file conversion, documented version-compatibility limits for Terraform state and configs, and explicit hands-on evidence of state carry-over.
